mapper.insert: INSERT INTO persons (id, family_id, first_name, last_name, display_name, gender, birth_year, death_year, hidden) VALUES (#{id}, #{familyId}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{displayName}, #{gender}, #{birthYear}, #{deathYear}, #{hidden})
mapper.update: UPDATE persons SET first_name = COALESCE(#{firstName}, first_name), last_name = COALESCE(#{lastName}, last_name), display_name = COALESCE(#{displayName}, display_name), gender = COALESCE(#{gender}, gender), birth_year = COALESCE(#{birthYear}, birth_year), death_year = COALESCE(#{deathYear}, death_year), hidden = #{hidden}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, family_id, first_name, last_name FROM persons WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, family_id, display_name, gender, birth_year, death_year, hidden FROM persons WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, family_id, first_name, last_name FROM persons WHERE family_id = #{familyId}
SELECT id, family_id, display_name, gender, birth_year, death_year, hidden FROM persons WHERE family_id = #{familyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM persons WHERE id = #{id} AND family_id = #{familyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM persons WHERE family_id = #{familyId}
SELECT id, family_id, display_name, gender, birth_year, death_year, hidden FROM persons WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND hidden = FALSE ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
